4imol.note: Imola GP out lap from the pits, Murcielago, analog input, Difficulty Type 2 with Steering Help/Brake Help/Stability Control/Auto Clutch/Invulnerability on (see CLAUDE.md). Tuned 2026-11-11 by gtr2-tune-lap.py, three passes (12, 14 and 11 trials; pass 3 best 153.1 s). With the garage-safe exit (drive straight to the pit-stop point, merge slowly: no wall hits) two verification runs gave 154.4 s and 154.4 s, 0.46% and 0.49% off the road (limit 0.5%), largest offset 6.2 m. Shift rpm 7200 is the Murcielago's rev limiter.
